description: An illustrative record for an open-weight model on a local endpoint through the OpenAI-compatible wire (an Ollama- or vLLM-style server), as the Desk's endpoint probe would record one: a 32,768-token window with 4,096 for output, no native tool calls (its chat template has none, so the tools are described in text and called in a fenced JSON block), no parallel calls, no vision, a reasoning_effort it takes and ignores, and its reasoning streamed under reasoning. Written by hand, not measured against a live endpoint; the harness runs the recorded scenario on it (packages/harness/capabilities.test.ts). What the record replaces is listed in source: a key required where none is needed is the relay's and stays the Desk's.

files: web/src/assistant/context/policy.ts (the 65,536-token default window the record replaces)
web/src/assistant/thinking.ts (reasoning_effort, sent whether or not the endpoint reads it)
